name: Amazon Business Prime Card

welcome_offer.description: N/A: no longer offered by American Express (replaced by U.S. Bank cards on 2026-08-14).

sources.notes: Official Amex notice: Amazon Business cards replaced by U.S. Bank cards on August 14, 2026 (checked 2026-10-19).

_no_credits_note: Amazon Business Prime Amex ($0 AF, requires Amazon Business Prime ~$179/yr) — no fixed-USD recurring credits. Value is earning rates (5% Amazon for Prime members up to $150k/yr) + Venue Collection 10% concession + employee cards. Verified 2026-04-27.
_card_status_alert: Replaced by the U.S. Bank Prime Business World Elite Mastercard on 2026-08-14 (official Amex notice).
discontinued_notes: American Express no longer issues this card: per the official Amex program-update notice, the Amazon Business American Express cards were replaced by U.S. Bank-issued Amazon business cards on August 14, 2026. The U.S. Bank successor is the Prime Business World Elite Mastercard (see us-bank-prime-business). Historical record.
